hard.q: Find the future value of an ordinary annuity of \(\$500\) deposited annually for 3 years at \(2\%\) annual interest, correct to 2 decimal places.
hard.sol: Working through this additional-topics step: \( FV=PMT\times\dfrac{(1+i)^n-1}{i}=500\times\dfrac{(1+0.02)^{3}-1}{0.02}\approx \$1,530.20 \)

hard.sol: Working through this additional-topics step: \( \text{Steady state: }\pi_1=\dfrac{2}{5}/(\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{2}{5})=\dfrac{2}{3} \)
